g.text: KMP next 数组推导 (模式串 "abacab")

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: idx=0: "a" → 无真前缀=真后缀 → next[0] = 0
idx=1: "ab" → 无真前缀=真后缀 → next[1] = 0
idx=2: "aba" → 前缀"a" = 后缀"a" → next[2] = 1
idx=3: "abac" → 无真前缀=真后缀 → next[3] = 0
idx=4: "abaca" → 前缀"a" = 后缀"a" → next[4] = 1
idx=5: "abacab" → 前缀"ab" = 后缀"ab" → next[5] = 2

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 当 j 处失配 → j = next[j-1]

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 模式串跳过「不可能匹配」的位置，i 不回退
